summary: Patria Investments Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice of its 2026 Annual General Meeting, a proxy statement, and a proxy card. The AGM will be held virtually from Grand Cayman on October 26, 2026 at 3:00 p.m. Eastern. Shareholders of record of Class A and Class B common shares as of the September 22, 2026 record date will vote on ratifying FY2025 financial statements and appointing Alfonso Duval, Ana Russo, and Andre Sales as directors. The Board recommends voting FOR all resolutions. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation. Watch for ordinary governance outcomes only.
